title: Telegram AI bot
description: My recent Project: An AI-powered Telegram bot that handles customer inquiries on behalf of a mobile store owner. * Provides specific answers based on the business data (working hours, address, products list, refund policy, etc) * remembers the context, the user doesn't need to repeat himself with every text * Communicates in the friendly tone of a welcoming assistant * Supports multiple languages, including English and Arabic * Always on — saves hours of customer support
